claim: Da, Liu and Schaumburg distinguish liquidity-related reversals among recent losers from sentiment-related reversals among recent winners; this motivates a separate long-side test, not a claim that saved modern daily model rankings are profitable.
impact_on_spec: Fixed long/cash translation of existing U500/H5 model scores with matched rule/liquidity/market controls.
limitations: Original monthly study uses analyst forecast revisions and a historical 1982-2009 sample. The local daily feature model is an adaptation, not a replication; original losing net local books remain counterevidence.
verification_method: Original official PDF opened through web on 2026-11-02; pages 1-5, especially long/short distinction on printed page 5; existing full text retained.
